QuestInfo.name: Arec's Letter of Introduction
QuestInfo.0: You have reached a limit in Thief training. You wonder if there's a level beyond this... Talk to #b#p2020011##k, who helped you with the 3rd job advancement, and ask about the path of a Thief.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2020011##k told me to see the bishop  #b#p2081400##k in Minar Forest if I want to find the path of becoming a more secretive thief
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2081400##k said she will guide me to the path that will lead me to the thief's extreme power.

0.0: Long time no see. I heard about you. You seem to have had a hard time. Did you find darkness within you? Then you must have a reason for being here. What can I do for you?\r\n#b#L0# I want the 4th job advancement.#l
0.1: I knew that you would return to see me someday. But I have no power to make your wish come true. Go to #bMinar Forest#k. If you find #b#p2081400##k, she may be able help you. Would you like to meet her?

yes.0: I'll write a recommendation letter for you. Hope you get a new power.

no.0: Aren't you here for the 4th job advancement? If you don't want to that's fine.

1.0: What are you doing here, young Thief?\r\n#b#L0# I want the 4th advancement. I have a recommendation letter from #p2020011#.#l
1.1: #b#p2020011##k?... The one in El Nath? Then I can trust you.

yes.0: A young Thief dreaming of a being a Nightlord or Shadower. I have a few stories to tell you, my stealthy friend. Talk to me when you're ready.

npc.0: Remember? It was #b#p2081400##k, the priest of Minar Forest. Go find her.

lost.0: You lost #b#t4031342##k? I will write again but be careful.
